# CaseInsensitiveStringFunctionsMissUse

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `CaseInsensitiveStringFunctionsMissUseInspection`

Case-insensitive search functions (`stripos`, `strripos`, `stristr`) do extra
case-folding work. When the needle has no letters at all (e.g. `'/'`, `'::'`,
`'42'`), case does not matter and the plain case-sensitive counterpart gives
the same result faster.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7,8,13} [Before]
<?php
function parts($path, $mode)
{
    $sep = '::';
    $a = stripos($path, '/');
    $b = strripos($path, '.', -2);
    $c = \stristr($path, $sep);
    $d = stripos($path, "2024");

    $e = stripos($path, 'x');
    $f = strripos($path, 'ß');
    $g = stristr($path, '');
    $h = stripos($path, "\t");
    $i = stripos($path, $mode);
    $j = stripos($path);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i, $j];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function parts($path, $mode)
{
    $sep = '::';
    $a = strpos($path, '/');
    $b = strrpos($path, '.', -2);
    $c = \strstr($path, $sep);
    $d = strpos($path, "2024");

    $e = stripos($path, 'x');
    $f = strripos($path, 'ß');
    $g = stristr($path, '');
    $h = strpos($path, "\t");
    $i = stripos($path, $mode);
    $j = stripos($path);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i, $j];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Needle has no letters; use &#39;strpos(...)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 6: Needle has no letters; use &#39;strrpos(...)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 7: Needle has no letters; use &#39;strstr(...)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 8: Needle has no letters; use &#39;strpos(...)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 13: Needle has no letters; use &#39;strpos(...)&#39; instead.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "CaseInsensitiveStringFunctionsMissUse": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore CaseInsensitiveStringFunctionsMissUse

/**
 * @noinspection CaseInsensitiveStringFunctionsMissUseInspection
 */
```
